raw_context:
Shoprite Holdings sells and distributes
thousands of national and multi-national consumer brands, alongside an extensive portfolio of its own private label and exclusive house brands
Shoprite Holdings
Private Label & House Brands
Ritebrand & Ubrand:
Budget-friendly staples found in Shoprite and Usave stores.
Forage and Feast & Simple Truth:
Premium and health-conscious food lines from Checkers.
Crystal Valley & Pot O' Gold:
Dairy and everyday grocery selections.
Homegrown:
Locally sourced items from small South African businesses.
Oh My Goodness:
Healthy children's meals co-developed with chef Gordon Ramsay and his daughter Matilda.
Bowl & Basket & Paperbird:
Flagship food and household lines (primarily utilized by the American Supermarket namesake counterpart).
Shoprite Holdings
Major Distribution & Supply Divisions
Freshmark:
The group's internal procurement and distribution arm handling fresh fruit and vegetables.
Transpharm:
A specialized pharmaceutical distributor supplying hospitals, veterinary surgeons, and clinics.
Red Star Wholesale:
Bulk wholesale distribution services for independent traders and franchisees.
